breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to recognize that the high pressure ratio (20% of static pressure) necessitates a compressible flow model. The ground truth corrects this by specifying the use of compressible isentropic relations, but the generated specification proceeds with the flawed incompressible assumption.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The agent explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use the "incompressible Bernoulli relation." This is the exact error the inconsistency highlights. The ground truth correctly replaces this with the appropriate compressible relations, a correction the agent completely missed.
